articles.title: When Time Runs Out, Scientists Test a Nuclear Plan to Stop an Asteroid
articles.summary: Scientists simulated using a nuclear blast above a large asteroid to push it off course or break it apart when warning time is very short.

articles.title: Switzerland Has Lost Nearly a Fifth of Its Glacier Ice in Just Five Years
articles.summary: Swiss glaciers lost over 5 percent of their ice in 2026, adding up to nearly 20 percent lost in five years after a dry winter and hot summer.
